caseNameFull: Puerto Rico v. Rubert Hermanos, Inc.
attorneys: Messrs. William Cattron Rigby, Nathan R. Margold, and George A. Malcolm for petitioner., Mr. Henri Brown for respondent., By leave of Court, Solicitor General Jackson filed a brief on behalf of the United States, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the First Circuit granted.
